author: Mark Atwood
text:
HALF DONE 2026-11-25. The half that needed no decision is shipped; the
rest waits on bead mimid-1wgh.114.1, which waits on Mark
(mimid-1wgh.128).

FOUND AND FIXED: a call's own room was appearing as an IRC CHANNEL. This
bead asked that IRC not show a keyed call "as a joinable thing"; it was
doing worse than that. `Names::note_room` gives a channel to every active
room that is not `direct`, and a call room is active and not direct, so
every keyed call made an UNNAMED channel appear in every IRC client of
every participant — one whose signalling messages are not content and
whose join does nothing. That is the trap in this bead's title, and
nothing in mimid-agent-irc mentioned `parent` or call rooms at all.

Now `note_room` gives a call room no channel and gives up any name held
for it, exactly as it does for a direct room, with the same test the JMAP
front end's `Render::is_call_room` makes. Tested, including a room that
becomes parent-dependent after it already had a channel.

ALREADY TRUE, so item 2 of this bead needs no code: IRC cannot offer to
start a keyed call. The service's `call` command requires a URL
(`usage: call #channel <url> [<description>]`), so it can only ever send
the LINK kind. There is no path from IRC to `Store::start_call`.

STILL TO DO, both blocked on the announcement:

• THE NOTICE. This bead wants "a notice naming who started it, and saying
  this client cannot join". Who started it comes from bead
  mimid-1wgh.114.1's announcement, which is a message in the parent chat
  that IRC renders as text. Until then an IRC user sees silence rather
  than a trap, which is better but is not what this bead asks for.
• NOT RENDERING THE ANNOUNCEMENT AS JOINABLE. Nothing to do until there
  is an announcement to render.

A SEPARATE GAP FOUND WHILE HERE, not fixed: an INVITE to a call room
cannot be told apart from any other invite, because `record::Invite` has
no parent field — `Agent::invite_details` does not surface the Welcome's
`parent_room`. With `invites = "any"` the room is joined and this never
shows; with a stricter policy a user gets a pending invite to a call room
they cannot use. Fixing it means carrying `parent_room` out of the
Welcome in mimid-agent-core, which is more than this bead.
